# S5 native GUI report acceptance input bytes

These are **original, unchanged** RORBwin 6.52 reports from the public
[Chain-Frost/ryan-tools-test-data](https://github.com/Chain-Frost/ryan-tools-test-data/tree/f3c49e867cd8a165e031217a148293a8968c2d88/RORB/12hr-areal-example),
pinned source commit `f3c49e867cd8a165e031217a148293a8968c2d88`:

- `rorbwin652-12h-standard.out` is source `Fig6_7_ aep0p2EY_du12hourtp1.out`: Git blob `95826bccdbe1f2410ef372ef6b6c2c161d847b99`, 19,020 bytes, 301 original hydrograph rows.
- `rorbwin652-12h-batch.out` is source `Fig6_7_batch.out`: Git blob `08ae1d94ef74d666836c8d3fab842e6421851030`, 8,558 bytes, 80 events and 8 representative references.

The bytes and source Git blob IDs matched exactly on copying; `.gitattributes`
disables line-ending conversion. These reports are **not** CMD 6.44 reference
observations, do not establish executable identity, and are not additional CMD
eligible population members. They are a separate retained reader-acceptance
sample; do not add them to the CMD regression register or silently regenerate
their original tokens.
